title: Dockerfile served from the web root
description: The response is a Dockerfile: build instructions starting with FROM and continuing into RUN steps. It names the base image and its tag, the packages installed, the build arguments and the paths the image writes.
remediation: Exclude build files from the deployed tree (.dockerignore at build time and a deny rule on the server), and rebuild the image if a build argument carried a secret.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the build instruction shape; it does not resolve the base image or prove that a build argument in it is still valid.

observation.body:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
CMD ["node","server.js"]

FROM python:3.12-slim
ARG PIP_INDEX_URL
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY app /app
Write a Dockerfile with a pinned base image and a single RUN layer.
